title: Program register state
statement: A program register state is a tuple of nine natural numbers $(p,n,a,b,s,t,tmp,st,nx)$, representing respectively the input pointer, vertex count, row counter, column counter, source or current vertex, target, scratch copy, step count, and guessed next vertex.
